name: Khurdopin ice-dammed lake
coord_source: HMAGLOFDB v1.3.0 (Zenodo 18257243, CC0) lake point, the dataset of Shrestha et al. 2023, ESSD 15:3941
lake_state_source: the basin against the Khurdopin glacier tongue is a dry sediment flat in Sentinel-2, 17 Aug 2026 (clearest scene of 1 Jul–30 Sep 2026); the lake last formed in 2017–2021 (HMAGLOFDB events 2017, 2018 and 2021)
forming_share_source: the Shimshal River runs through the 1 km circle: on all 14 clear Sentinel-2 scenes of 15 Jun–30 Sep 2026 the empty zone read 7.8–13.3% water (0.24–0.42 km2), so only water above 16% (about 0.08 km2 more than the river's highest) says a lake may be forming; a lake as small as the 2017 one (0.043 km2) would not show. Since 14 Nov 2026 the river channel (forming_exclude) is left out of the zone and the 16% applies to the rest (2.90 km2): there the empty zone read 0.95–14.7% water (median 4.1%) on the 25 clear scenes of 15 Jul–31 Oct 2026, and the back-test of 8 Oct 2025–14 Nov 2026 (lakes-absence-backtest) changes state on no scene
forming_exclude_source: the Shimshal River channel in the 1 km circle: water (MNDWI > 0) on at least 60% of the 25 clear, snow-free Sentinel-2 L2A scenes of 15 Jul–31 Oct 2026 (lakes-absence-backtest --persistent-out), 0.24 km2. With the channel in the zone, floodplain melt water from late April to June 2026 read as a lake forming from 9 May to 8 Jun 2026; with it left out, no change of state from 8 Oct 2025 to 14 Nov 2026
limits: The Sentinel-2 check for a lake forming here leaves out the Shimshal River channel (0.24 km² of the 1 km circle) and needs water on more than 16% of the rest, about 0.46 km². Outside the channel the empty zone reads up to 15% water in summer and autumn, so the check cannot see a lake smaller than about 0.04 km², and a lake under about 0.34 km² shows only when the floodplain is already wet.
elevation_source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N36_00_E075_00_DEM, Earth Search), 10th percentile within 1 km of the lake point
district_source: geoBoundaries gbOpen PAK ADM2 and ADM1 (release 9469f09, built 12 Dec 2023, public domain), simplified to 0.001°
